description: This Kotlin class 'NodeApp' extends Android's Application class and manages the lifecycle and singleton access to a 'NodeRuntime' instance, including setup for debugging policies during development.

classes.name: NodeApp
classes.description: Main Application class managing NodeRuntime instance and debugging configurations.
